descriptions.notStarted: It's time to take my mount to another level! Let's go see #p2081000# in Leafre and see if he has any methods to improve my mount!
descriptions.inProgress: After reaching Leafre, I spoke with #p2081000#. He confirmed that he does have a way to improve my mount--by turning it into a powerful dragon! However, like most good things in life, this is not free. He's agreed to sell me the dragon's perfume for the low, discounted price of #r20 million mesos#k because it is rare. Really rare. So rare, in fact, that he still has his original stockpile. At 20 Million mesos per, I'm not surprised...
descriptions.completed: After thinking it over, I gave #p2081000# 20 million mesos and got the dragon's perfume. I took a whiff, it smells like candy, chocolate, and roses...I'm tempted to drink it! However, I want an awesome dragon mount, so I'll have to pass. I can't wait to ride it!
